name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Deal time was started over 50 years ago in 1963 by Alf Temme who had this idea of bringing his sauna experience from Sweden to California. Armed with a few hand tools and saws he built his first sauna for a contractor in the Hollywood Hills. From there it grew into a business to include jetted spa tubs, steambaths, wine rooms, cold plunge tubs, fitness equipment and other wellness therapy rooms.



Today we supply saunas and wellness products from coast to coast though out the US. We love what we do and want to convey that to our customers. We are here for you and to help you relax by having the ultimate “spa experience”.



We provide a full service helping you to select the appropriate site, sauna design, and selection of wood type, needed supplies, outfitting, sauna installation and regular maintenance. Our staff is highly knowledgeable, experienced and are happy to pass this knowledge on so you can enjoy a perfect sauna.
